hero_title: The operating system for product teams.
hero_subhead: One framework. Three workshops. Your entire team aligned on what to build, why, and what comes next.
method_1_p: One session. Your team leaves with one metric, four inputs that drive it, and a prioritized list of what to build next. No more guessing. No more politics.
method_2_p: Is your product solving the right problem for the right person? We dissect your market position across six dimensions and surface the gaps before they become expensive mistakes.
method_3_p: What are you most likely wrong about? We identify the highest-risk assumption in your strategy and design the cheapest possible test to validate it before you build.
os_1_p: Your North Star, your roadmap, and your team's decision log — all pre-configured and connected.
os_2_p: GSheets templates wired to the model. Track the numbers that actually move your North Star.
os_3_p: Scrum and kanban boards with the methodology baked in. Every ticket tested against the North Star before it ships.
cta_p: One free session is all it takes to see the difference a shared North Star makes.
